data.title: 爱丽丝 · 湖畔木屋炉火旁的卸甲倾心
data.description: 森林木屋温暖的壁炉前，爱丽丝身穿纯白丝质睡袍坐在厚厚羊毛地毯上，双手抱着膝盖凝视着跳动的火苗，转头看向身侧时满眼倾慕柔情。
data.action: sitting by hearth, soft nightgown, resting chin on knee, tender blushing gaze
data.lighting: crackling orange firelight enveloping bare skin and blonde hair
data.mood: deeply romantic and intimate sanctuary warmth
data.promptProse: Seated before a crackling fireplace in a peaceful wooden cabin, Alice rests her chin on her knees in a flowing white gown, her golden braid glowing amber in the hearthlight as she gazes softly.
data.animaCaption: Alice resting beside a warm fireplace with a tender, blushing expression.
